softwareUpdater.pageDescription: Compares each app's installed version with the one offered by your package managers. Only the apps you select are updated; some installers ask for administrator consent.
softwareUpdater.managerEnabledHint: {{manager}} is included in the check. Click to leave it out.
softwareUpdater.managerDisabledHint: {{manager}} is left out of the check. Click to include it.
softwareUpdater.managerScanFailedHint_one: Apps installed with this manager are missing from the list and may have updates available.
softwareUpdater.managerScanFailedHint_other: Apps installed with these managers are missing from the list and may have updates available.

packageManagerNotFound.brewRequired: Homebrew is required. Install it from
packageManagerNotFound.wingetRequired: Windows Package Manager is required. Install it from the
packageManagerNotFound.chocoRequired: Chocolatey is required. Install it from
packageManagerNotFound.aptRequired: The APT package manager is required. It is usually pre-installed on Debian and Ubuntu.
packageManagerNotFound.dnfRequired: The DNF package manager is required. It is usually pre-installed on Fedora and RHEL.
packageManagerNotFound.pacmanRequired: The Pacman package manager is required. It is usually pre-installed on Arch Linux.
packageManagerNotFound.noPackageManager: No supported package manager found. Supported: apt (Debian and Ubuntu), dnf (Fedora and RHEL) and pacman (Arch).
packageManagerNotFound.windowsManagerHint: Checking and installing updates needs at least one of winget (App Installer), Chocolatey, Scoop and npm.

softwareUpdater.slowInstallHint: The installer is still running. Large apps can take several minutes.
softwareUpdater.elevatedStep: Running as administrator: approve the Windows prompt if it appears
softwareUpdater.resultPending: {{app}} is still installing in the background. Check again in a few minutes.
softwareUpdater.emptyStateDescription: No update check in this session.
softwareUpdater.checkManagersWindows: winget, Chocolatey, Scoop and npm, when installed and included
softwareUpdater.checkManagersLinux: apt, dnf or pacman, whichever the system has
softwareUpdater.checkVersionsDetail: Each app's installed version against the latest one its manager offers
softwareUpdater.checkIgnoredDetail: Left out of the list until you restore them
softwareUpdater.checkingSubtext: This can take a moment: each package manager checks its own apps.
softwareUpdater.allUpToDateTitle: All up to date · checked at {{time}}
softwareUpdater.allUpToDateDescription: None of the apps handled by the included package managers has a newer version available.
softwareUpdater.errorUpdateFailed: The update stopped because of an unexpected error.

driverManager.pageDescription: Looks in Windows Update for newer versions of your installed drivers and, in the Driver Store, for driver packages replaced by a newer version. Drivers in use are never removed; some updates need a restart.

progress.querying: Searching Windows Update for driver updates…

driverManager.rebootRequired: restart needed to finish the installation
driverManager.emptyStateDescription: No driver scan in this session.
driverManager.checkUpdatesDetail: Newer versions Windows Update offers for the installed devices
driverManager.checkStaleDetail: Old versions in the Driver Store, replaced by a newer copy of the same driver in use
driverManager.checkActiveDetail: Excluded from cleanup: never offered for removal
driverManager.allUpToDateTitle: No updates and no stale packages
driverManager.allUpToDateDescription: Windows Update offers no newer versions and the Driver Store holds no replaced packages.
driverManager.noUpdatesDescription: Windows Update offers no newer versions for the installed devices.
driverManager.noStaleDescription: The Driver Store holds no packages replaced by a newer version.
driverManager.updatesDisabledTitle: Driver updates are turned off in Windows
driverManager.updatesDisabledText: Windows is set to exclude drivers from Windows Update, so driver updates were not checked. Stale package cleanup still works. Driver updates can be turned back on in the Windows device installation settings or in Group Policy.
driverManager.ignoredToastHidden: SuperSonicCleaner won't offer this driver again, and it's now hidden from Windows Update too.
driverManager.ignoredToastNotHidden: SuperSonicCleaner won't offer this driver again, but it couldn't be hidden from Windows Update. Run SuperSonicCleaner as administrator and restore, then ignore it again to hide it there as well.
driverManager.restoredToastNotUnhidden: The driver is back in SuperSonicCleaner's list but couldn't be unhidden in Windows Update. Run SuperSonicCleaner as administrator to change that.
driverManager.ignoreFailedToast: Couldn't update the driver ignore list
driverManager.confirmInstallBody_one: {{count}} update from Windows Update will be installed; a restart may be needed afterwards.
driverManager.confirmInstallBody_other: {{count}} updates from Windows Update will be installed; a restart may be needed afterwards.
driverManager.confirmRemoveBody_one: {{count}} stale package will be removed from the Driver Store ({{size}}). Removal is not reversible.
driverManager.confirmRemoveBody_other: {{count}} stale packages will be removed from the Driver Store ({{size}}). Removal is not reversible.
driverManager.confirmActiveNote: Drivers in use are not touched.
driverManager.scanFailedDescription: Make sure the app is running as administrator
driverManager.scanFailedError: Failed to scan driver packages. Make sure the app is running as administrator.
driverManager.updateScanFailedDescription: Make sure the Windows Update service is running
driverManager.updateScanFailedError: Failed to check for driver updates. Make sure the Windows Update service is running.
driverManager.installFailedError: Failed to install driver updates. Administrator privileges are required.
driverManager.cleanFailedError: Failed to remove driver packages. Administrator privileges are required.
